summary: A/B testing experiment caused elevated 429s in eu-west by routing traffic to constrained capacity pool
content:
Issue summary
- Customer: AcmeAI (Dedicated)
- Route: /v1/chat/completions (project: acme-prod)
- Region: eu-west
- Symptom: spike in HTTP 429 responses during an active route-level A/B experiment; customer observed intermittent failures and a sharp increase in retries.

Impact
- Customer reported ~6–12% request failure rate (429) on eu-west for ~27 minutes.
- End-user impact: chat responses failing; some clients retried and caused secondary latency increase.
- No data loss; requests rejected at gateway.

What happened (initial assessment)
- A route-level A/B experiment was configured to send a portion of traffic to Variant B, which mapped to a smaller / constrained capacity pool in eu-west.
- The configured split (80/20) was within expectation, but Variant B’s pool had insufficient headroom and began returning capacity-based throttles.
- Because the error surfaced as 429 (capacity_exceeded) rather than a 5xx, customer retry logic increased load and amplified the impact.

Timeline (UTC)
- 09:12 Customer reports elevated 429s via shared Slack connect; ticket opened.
- 09:15 Support confirms increased 429 rate on Redwood side in eu-west; pages SRE.
- 09:18 SRE correlates start time with A/B experiment exposure logs for acme-prod (experiment_id: exp_acme_20260218_euw).
- 09:22 Mitigation: stop/disable experiment in eu-west, revert route to control (Variant A).
- 09:27 429 rate returns to baseline.
- 09:40 Customer confirms recovery.

Environment / configuration
- Experiment: exp_acme_20260218_euw
- Variants:
  - A (control): rw-chat-13b-v2 (eu-west dedicated pool: acme-euw-gpu-prod)
  - B (treatment): rw-chat-13b-v2-q4 (eu-west pool: acme-euw-gpu-burst)
- Split: 80% A / 20% B
- Guardrails: not yet enforcing automated rollback on 429 threshold for beta partner experiments.

Steps to reproduce (internal)
1) In eu-west, configure route-level experiment to route traffic to a variant backed by a pool with limited max_concurrency / GPU count.
2) Generate sustained traffic above Variant B pool throughput.
3) Observe gateway emitting 429 with reason=capacity_exceeded for requests assigned to B.

Observed behavior
- Gateway responses:
  - HTTP 429
  - error.type=rate_limit
  - error.code=capacity_exceeded
  - request tags: experiment_id=exp_acme_20260218_euw, variant=B, region=eu-west
- Metrics:
  - 429 rate increase aligned with experiment exposures.
  - Variant B p95 latency also increased before throttling as the pool saturated.

Expected behavior
- Experiment should not be startable (or should auto-stop) if the chosen variant has insufficient capacity headroom in the target region.
- If throttling occurs, guardrails should trigger an automatic rollback / traffic shift to control.

Immediate mitigation taken
- Disabled the experiment for eu-west and reverted routing policy to 100% control.
- Coordinated with AcmeAI to pause their rollout and reduce client retries temporarily.
- SRE monitored eu-west 429 and latency until stable for 30 minutes.

Root cause (confirmed)
- Experiment configuration allowed selecting a treatment variant that was not capacity-compatible with the requested split in eu-west.
- The capacity pool backing Variant B had fewer GPUs and lower max_inflight than needed, and there was no preflight validation step to block start.
- Beta guardrails and rollback automation were not yet enabled for this tenant/route (flagging gap).

Customer communication (external)
- We confirmed the errors were caused by our experiment routing sending traffic to a constrained pool in eu-west.
- We disabled the experiment and restored stable service.
- We committed to: (1) add validation to prevent starting experiments with insufficient headroom, and (2) enable 429-based guardrails with auto-rollback.

Internal notes / links
- Incident Slack thread: sources/slack/incidents/1707864418.json
- Related SRE discussion on guardrails: sources/slack/eng-sre/1707334988.json
- Runbook used: sources/confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/ab-testing-emergency-disable-and-rollback.json

Follow-ups / fixes
1) Guardrail + auto-rollback hook (treatment 429 threshold)
- Implement: auto-rollback when variant-level 429 rate > threshold over N minutes, with alerting to oncall.
- Tracking: sources/github/redwood/pr_18459_guardrail-evaluator-and-auto-rollback-hook.json
- Status: merged; rollout staged beginning 2026-02-21.

2) Beta gating alignment (ensure guardrails apply to all beta tenants)
- Ensure experiment feature flag enablement includes guardrail policies by default for Dedicated.
- Tracking: sources/github/redwood/pr_18491_feature-flag-console-ab-testing-beta.json

3) Preflight validation (capacity headroom checks)
- Action item: add validation on “Start experiment” to verify per-variant pool capacity and configured split vs recent throughput.
- Owner: Ethan Park / Mina Haddad
- Status: not in this ticket’s PR list; to be tracked in Eng backlog (follow-up created by SRE during incident).

4) Telemetry hardening
- Ensure exposure/variant tags remain within cardinality constraints while still enabling per-variant throttling detection.
- Tracking: sources/github/redwood/pr_18519_reduce-metric-cardinality-experiment-tags.json

Comments

2026-02-18 09:12 (Simran Kaur, Support)
Customer (AcmeAI) reports: “Seeing lots of 429s from eu-west only since we started the route A/B test. Can you confirm if there’s an issue on your side?”

2026-02-18 09:16 (Simran Kaur)
Acknowledged. Asked for request IDs and confirmed timeframe. Noted correlation with experiment start in Console.

2026-02-18 09:19 (Sean Gallagher, SRE)
Seeing elevated 429 in eu-west at gateway with tags experiment_id=exp_acme_20260218_euw variant=B. Variant B pool looks capacity constrained.

2026-02-18 09:22 (Sean Gallagher)
Mitigation in progress: disabling experiment in eu-west per runbook, reverting to control.

2026-02-18 09:27 (Sean Gallagher)
429 rate back to baseline; continuing to monitor.

2026-02-18 09:41 (Simran Kaur)
Customer confirms errors stopped. Requested RCA + prevention plan.

2026-02-20 14:05 (Allison Grant, Observability)
Added note: we should explicitly alert on variant-level 429 and not just overall route error-rate; otherwise experiment failures are masked when control is healthy.

2026-02-22 11:30 (Simran Kaur)
Shared summary + follow-up items with customer. Closing ticket; will reopen if preflight validation uncovers additional constraints for their eu-west pools.

Resolution
- Resolved by disabling the experiment for eu-west and reverting 100% traffic to control.
- Preventative work in progress: guardrail/auto-rollback rollout and beta flag/guardrail alignment; capacity preflight validation queued as a follow-up engineering task.

Post-incident action items (Support-visible)
- Ensure any future AcmeAI experiments in eu-west are started at <=5% treatment until headroom validation is available.
- Confirm guardrail automation is enabled for AcmeAI tenant once rollout completes.
